quantity_basis: Quantity derived from non-public N; one expedition per freight vehicle. Synthetic scenario, not measured demand.
restriction_basis: user-requested weekday scenario rule; not legal certification
route_access_basis: Principal-road through corridors with explicit OSM-boundary crossings; OSM access and lane movements checked, not surveyed truck authorizations.
outside_policy: boundary_entry_exit; outside travel is not simulated
visual_size_policy: same 12 x 2.5 m scenario body as TuBus_RigidProxy, shared by native vehicle length and replay; not measured geometry
dispatch_basis: Deterministic equal route quotas and stratified times over feasible allowed windows; free-flow route time plus existing clearance margin, not a guarantee under congestion.
route_preservation_basis: All historical principal links retained in order; local internal sections replaced and map-boundary gateway links extended.
corner_preference: Prefer opposite map sides and a southwestern-to-northeastern west-east corridor; preserve the other valid historical principal trunks before imposing diagonal detours.
